result:
Created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`, recording the current decision: TLS certificate verification is required on all builds, including development builds, with no dev exception.

This reflects the latest recorded exchange on the topic — an earlier workaround that disabled verification in dev builds was explicitly retracted in favor of requiring verification everywhere. A later note about allowing plain HTTP for internal hosts contradicted this, but that contradiction was flagged rather than accepted, so it didn't change the recorded decision. Note also that the on-disk `config/decisions/revoke-tls-verification.json` file (which still held the old, retracted workaround value) was deleted in a later "move decision config out of the tree" commit — per the project's memory rules, that deletion doesn't retire or restore either value, so I relied on the explicit retraction statement rather than the stale file content.
